description.narrative: THE PROJ AIMS AT THE CONSTRUCTION OF A HOSPITAL WITH A TOTAL CAPACITY OF 660 BEDS TO PROVIDE (I) CLINICAL PREPARATION AND TRAINING FOR MEDICAL STUDENTS OF THE FACULITIES OF MEDICINE NURSING SCHOOL OF NURSING OF TISHREEN UNIVERSITY (II) A RESEARCH CENTER FOR NUCLEAR MEDECINE TREATMENT BY X_RAY FOR THE GROWTH OF CANCEROUS DISEASES (III) A REFERRAL HOSPITAL FOR NEIGHBOURING GOVEMORATES.
